name: com.fujisheng.urui
description: Text-based HTML/CSS UI for AI-assisted Unity development, powered by URUI with a managed C# API.

samples.description: Run an orbital station with combat escorts, offline surveys, earned titles, beacon routes, loadouts and flight reports. Every bridge control uses a raised pointer-responsive keycap. Live glass refraction, instrument transitions and optional URUI Effect gauges and particles run in game.
Learning example. Managed Document, query, style updates and disposable click subscriptions.
Learning example. Explicit element creation, scoped queries, hierarchy, classes and click subscriptions; no data binding.
Learning example. Typed controls, form input, focus navigation and a reusable virtual list.
